hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung had learned countless martial arts over the years. Among them were everything from Peak-level arts that had once defined an era to Third Rate martial arts easily found even on a street stall in some backwater village.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung had learned countless martial arts over the years. They ranged from Peak-level arts that had once defined an era to Third Rate martial arts easily found at a street stall in some backwater village.

hunks.baseline: But at this very moment, he realized something.
hunks.sol: But at that moment, he realized something.

hunks.baseline: *It’s strong. Stronger than any martial art I’ve learned until now.*
hunks.sol: *It’s strong. Stronger than any martial art I’ve ever learned.*

hunks.baseline: A curved saber descended with the force of a single slash cleaving something in two.
hunks.sol: A curved saber descended with enough force to cleave anything in two.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t a Supreme Peak art like the Nangong Family’s Emperor Sword Form or Huashan’s Plum Blossom Sword Technique. This was the first move of the Three Calamities Sword Technique, Mount Tai Presses Down on the Crown—the move even a Third Rate street thug would know.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t a Supreme Peak art like the Nangong Family’s Emperor Sword Form or Huashan’s Plum Blossom Sword Technique. This was the first move of the Three Calamities Sword Technique, Mount Tai Presses Down on the Crown—a move even a Third Rate street thug would know.

hunks.baseline: The red saber qi rippling over the blade seemed capable of doing more than merely pressing down Mount Tai. It looked like it could split the mountain apart.
hunks.sol: The red saber qi rippling over the blade seemed capable of more than merely pressing down Mount Tai. It looked as though it could split the mountain apart.

hunks.baseline: In the briefest instant, Jin Mukyung threw himself aside without hesitation.
hunks.sol: In that split second, Jin Mukyung threw himself aside without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: The saber qi grazed Jin Mukyung’s clothes by a hair before striking the ground. The sight of the earth splitting wide open without a single boom or tremor sent a shiver through him.
hunks.sol: The saber qi grazed his clothes by a hair before striking the ground. The sight of the earth splitting wide open without a single boom or tremor was enough to send a shiver through him.

hunks.baseline: But Pung Yang was dissatisfied with the result.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang was dissatisfied with the result.

hunks.baseline: That had been an all-out attack. Even after drawing out 120 percent of the Temporary Strength Pill’s effects, he hadn’t managed to leave so much as a small wound on Jin Mukyung.
hunks.sol: That had been an all-out attack. Even after drawing out 120 percent of the Temporary Strength Pill’s effects, he hadn’t managed to leave so much as a scratch on Jin Mukyung.

hunks.baseline: *The Tiger of Mount Heng could barely parry that.*
hunks.sol: *The Tiger of Mount Heng could barely counter that.*

hunks.baseline: Even Cheol Mubaek, a fully mature Peak master, had suffered internal injuries and been forced to retreat in exchange for blocking it. So how had a brat not even thirty years old managed this?
hunks.sol: Even Cheol Mubaek, a seasoned Peak master, had suffered internal injuries and been forced to retreat after blocking it. So how had a brat not even thirty years old managed this?

hunks.baseline: “This much should be dodged.”
hunks.sol: “I should at least be able to dodge that much.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s not as though you couldn’t block it, is it?”
hunks.sol: “Because you couldn’t block it, perhaps?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course, a young master of the mighty Jin Family of Taiyuan would have been desperate enough to flee by rolling across the ground like a lazy donkey.”[^1]
hunks.sol: “Of course, a young master of the mighty Jin Family of Taiyuan must have been truly desperate to flee by rolling across the ground like a lazy donkey.”[^1]

hunks.baseline: The face that had remained impassive the entire time cracked into a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: His face had remained impassive the entire time, but now he let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Just thinking that if there are people who pelt Peak masters with rocks, rolling across the ground isn’t such a big deal.”
hunks.sol: “I was just thinking—if there are people who pelt Peak masters with rocks, is rolling across the ground really such a big deal?”

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang involuntarily asked in response to the nonsensical joke, unable to understand what he meant.

hunks.baseline: “Throwing rocks at a Peak master? Are they insane?”
hunks.sol: Unable to make sense of the absurd joke, Pung Yang asked without thinking, “Throwing rocks at a Peak master? Are they insane?”

hunks.baseline: That was when Pung Yang felt a faint sense of puzzlement.
hunks.sol: Just as Pung Yang began to wonder—

hunks.baseline: He turned around, and the face of a handsome young man was reflected in his red eyes.
hunks.sol: He spun around, and the face of a handsome young man was reflected in his red eyes.

hunks.baseline: Within the slow flow of time, Jin Taekyung grinned. The iron spear in his hands was already hurtling toward Pung Yang’s chest.
hunks.sol: As time slowed to a crawl, Jin Taekyung grinned. The iron spear in his hands was already hurtling toward Pung Yang’s chest.

hunks.baseline: My condition was perfect. Leveling up while dealing with the minions had completely restored my fatigue and Stamina.
hunks.sol: I was in perfect condition. Leveling up while dealing with the small fry had completely restored my fatigue and Stamina.

hunks.baseline: The timing was pretty good, too. Pung Yang’s broad, defenseless back looked like it was begging to be stabbed with a spear.
hunks.sol: The timing was pretty good, too. Pung Yang’s broad, defenseless back looked like it was begging me to stick a spear through it.

hunks.baseline: As the finishing touch to this beautiful picture, I chose One Annihilation. I hadn’t seen anyone remain fine after taking this attack.
hunks.sol: For the finishing touch to this beautiful picture, I chose One Annihilation. I had yet to see anyone take this attack and walk away unscathed.

hunks.baseline: A low voice like the growl of a beast.
hunks.sol: The voice was low, like the growl of a beast.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang was surrounded by a curtain of qi as red as his eyes. It had completely blocked the vortex unleashed by One Annihilation, and now writhed like living armor.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang was surrounded by a curtain of qi as red as his eyes. It had completely blocked the vortex unleashed by One Annihilation and now writhed like living armor.

hunks.baseline: As I stood there dumbfounded, the sight before my eyes going dark, Pung Yang curled up the corner of his mouth.
hunks.sol: I stood frozen, my vision going dark. Pung Yang curled one corner of his mouth.

hunks.baseline: “It’s too late for regret.”
hunks.sol: “It’s too late for regrets.”

hunks.baseline: A strand of saber qi shot up from his curved saber and sliced off a clump of my hair. I had bent at the waist just in time. If I had been even slightly slower, it would have been my head that was cut off.
hunks.sol: A strand of saber qi shot from his curved saber and sliced off a clump of my hair. I had ducked just in time. If I’d been even slightly slower, it would have been my head.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed the curse trying to burst out and leaped away. No sooner had I done so than savage saber strikes shredded the place where I had been standing.
hunks.sol: I swallowed the curse rising in my throat and flung myself away. The instant I moved, savage saber strikes shredded the spot where I had been standing.

hunks.baseline: The problem was that every strand of saber qi was unbelievably powerful. Seeing the frozen ground split apart like soft tofu sent a chill down my spine.
hunks.sol: The problem was that every strand of saber qi was unbelievably powerful. The sight of the frozen ground splitting apart like soft tofu sent a chill down my spine.

hunks.baseline: *If I make one wrong move, I’m really going to die.*
hunks.sol: *One wrong move and I’m really going to die.*

hunks.baseline: Even an A-rank magic armor wouldn’t have been enough here, yet I was fighting while wearing nothing but a scrap of cloth. It was like walking across a sheet of thin ice.
hunks.sol: Even A-rank magical armor might not have been enough here, yet I was fighting in nothing but a scrap of cloth. This was the very definition of walking on thin ice.

hunks.baseline: More than anything else…
hunks.sol: More importantly…

hunks.baseline: Maintaining Body-Protecting Qi alone had to consume a massive amount of internal energy, but Pung Yang seemed like a spring that would never run dry.
hunks.sol: Maintaining Body-Protecting Qi alone had to consume a tremendous amount of internal energy, but right now, Pung Yang seemed like an inexhaustible spring.

hunks.baseline: “I heard you two were brothers, but the way you run away like rats is exactly the same.”
hunks.sol: “I heard you two were brothers. The way you both run like rats really is identical.”

hunks.baseline: That was when a voice came from behind him.
hunks.sol: A voice came from behind him.

hunks.baseline: “It’s not exactly a pleasant thing to hear.”
hunks.sol: “That’s not particularly pleasant to hear.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung appeared out of nowhere and scattered a flurry of sword strikes. A long blue flash shot toward Pung Yang’s neck.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung appeared without warning and swung his sword. A streak of blue light shot straight toward Pung Yang’s neck.

hunks.baseline: But even Jin Mukyung’s Sword Energy, which seemed capable of cutting through anything, couldn’t pierce the Body-Protecting Qi. Pung Yang leisurely rubbed the neck struck by the Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: But even Jin Mukyung’s Sword Energy, which looked capable of cutting through anything, couldn’t pierce the Body-Protecting Qi. Pung Yang casually rubbed the spot on his neck where the Sword Energy had struck.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a little stiff. Is that all?”
hunks.sol: “A little stiff. Is that all?”

hunks.baseline: As Jin Mukyung charged in without hesitation, the curved saber in Pung Yang’s hand moved at the same time. The aura was so powerful that I could feel the flow of the air change.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung charged without hesitation, and the curved saber in Pung Yang’s hand moved at the same time. Their auras were so powerful that I could feel the flow of the air change.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t a fight I could join.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a fight I could interfere in.

hunks.baseline: At last, the moment Jin Mukyung’s blue Sword Energy met Pung Yang’s red saber qi, a tremendous wave of force erupted along with a boom loud enough to make my ears ring.
hunks.sol: The instant Jin Mukyung’s blue Sword Energy met Pung Yang’s red saber qi, a tremendous wave of force erupted with a boom loud enough to make my ears ring.

hunks.baseline: Most of the people standing firmly on both feet lost their balance and staggered.
hunks.sol: Most of those standing nearby lost their balance and staggered.

hunks.baseline: But I widened my eyes and watched the result of this incredible clash.
hunks.sol: But I kept my eyes wide open, watching for the result of that incredible clash.

hunks.baseline: A sword and saber reduced to nothing but their hilts. Tightly pressed lips.
hunks.sol: Their sword and saber had been reduced to nothing but hilts. Their lips were pressed tightly shut.

hunks.baseline: The man kneeling on the ground spat out dark red blood.
hunks.sol: The bastard on his knees spat out dark red blood.

hunks.baseline: A small cheer rose through the battlefield. Jin Mukyung stood proudly while Pung Yang knelt on the ground. The winner of this fierce battle had been decided.
hunks.sol: A small cheer rose across the battlefield. Jin Mukyung stood tall while Pung Yang knelt on the ground. The outcome of this fierce battle had been decided.

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t been able to see the entire exchange, but there was no doubt that Pung Yang had suffered internal injuries first.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t seen the entire exchange, but Pung Yang must have been the first to suffer internal injuries.

hunks.baseline: The proof was the distinct palm print stamped across his chest—something that hadn’t been there before. That must have been the decisive blow.
hunks.sol: The proof was the distinct palm print stamped across his chest—something that hadn’t been there before. That had probably been the decisive blow.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and staggered to his feet.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang wiped the blood from his mouth and staggered to his feet.

hunks.baseline: When Jin Mukyung gave him no answer, Pung Yang clicked his tongue.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung gave no answer. Pung Yang clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. Even after using the Temporary Strength Pill, I’ve ended up like this. I suppose I should hole up in some remote mountain valley and train my martial arts for a while.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. Even after using the Temporary Strength Pill, I’ve ended up like this. I suppose I’ll have to hole up in some remote mountain valley and train my martial arts for a while.”

hunks.baseline: I was genuinely curious.
“Where are you going?”
hunks.sol: Genuinely curious, I asked, “Where are you going?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I need the martial arts formulas you know from the Jin Family of Taiyuan. They should be a great help in supplementing the violent qi circulation of the Crimson Blood Cultivation Technique.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I need the martial arts formulas you know from the Jin Family of Taiyuan. They should help me compensate for the violent qi circulation of the Crimson Blood Cultivation Technique.”

hunks.baseline: After hearing that much, the words that had been lingering on the tip of my tongue came out on their own.
hunks.sol: Once I’d heard that much, the words lingering on the tip of my tongue slipped out on their own.

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t checked, but everyone probably wore the same expression I did.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t checked, but everyone probably had the same look on their face as I did.

hunks.baseline: The battle had already clearly decided its winner, and yet—what?
hunks.sol: The winner had already been decided, and yet—what?

hunks.baseline: “Forget your remote mountain valley training. I’ll send you on a filial-piety tour of Mount Beimang. You can train there.”[^3]
hunks.sol: “Forget training in some remote mountain valley. I’ll send you on a filial-piety tour of Mount Beimang. You can train there.”[^3]

hunks.baseline: “Even if it isn’t me personally, there are plenty of people behind you who can send you to Mount Beimang.”
hunks.sol: “Even if I can’t do it myself, there are plenty of people behind you who can.”

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect were already approaching slowly, weapons drawn.
hunks.sol: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect were already creeping closer with their weapons drawn.

hunks.baseline: *This man isn’t going to get an easy death.*
hunks.sol: *This man isn’t going to die peacefully.*

hunks.baseline: It was time for him to pay for the karma of his past misdeeds. I flicked my spear toward Pung Yang.
hunks.sol: It was time for him to pay for all the evil he had done. I gestured at Pung Yang with my spear.

hunks.baseline: “Are you still going to keep spouting nonsense?”
hunks.sol: “Still going to keep spouting nonsense?”

hunks.baseline: The bastard stared at us for a moment before opening his mouth.
hunks.sol: The bastard stared at us for a moment before speaking.

hunks.baseline: “Perhaps you’re under a serious misconception.”
hunks.sol: “I think you’re laboring under a serious misconception.”

hunks.baseline: The laugh in his voice was impossible to hide.
hunks.sol: The laughter in his voice was impossible to hide.

hunks.baseline: “If you find that hard to believe, it would be faster to ask the Heaven Shaking Sword standing before me. Well, what do you think of what I’ve said?”
hunks.sol: “If you find that hard to believe, it would be faster to ask the Heaven Shaking Sword standing before me. Well? What do you think?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung didn’t answer Pung Yang’s question, and only then did I realize it.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung didn’t answer Pung Yang’s question.

hunks.baseline: Why he hadn’t said a word for some time. Why he had done nothing but stand in place like a stone statue.
hunks.sol: Only then did I realize why he hadn’t said a word for some time. Why he had stood there like a stone statue without moving.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang’s hand touched Jin Mukyung’s chest. At what point had it happened? His body had already lost consciousness, and now it crumpled limply.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang’s hand touched Jin Mukyung’s chest. How long had it been? His unconscious body crumpled limply to the ground.

hunks.baseline: Only then did I see the five throwing knives embedded in his upper body in a neat row.
hunks.sol: Only then did I see the five throwing knives embedded in a neat row across his upper body.

hunks.baseline: The red eyes sweeping across the silent crowd curved like crescent moons.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang’s red eyes swept across the silent crowd and curved into crescent moons.

hunks.baseline: “Well, shall we finish things up?”
hunks.sol: “Well, shall we finish this?”

hunks.baseline: It started with the more than ten throwing knives that shot from Pung Yang’s sleeve as he approached us at an easy pace.
hunks.sol: It started with the dozen or so throwing knives that shot from Pung Yang’s sleeve as he approached us at an easy pace.

hunks.baseline: It might have been a close-range attack, but it was a throwing-knife technique that even Jin Mukyung hadn’t been able to evade. Pung Yang’s knives pierced their targets with perfect accuracy, and screams rang out without fail.
hunks.sol: It might have been at close range, but this was a throwing-knife technique even Jin Mukyung had failed to evade. Pung Yang’s knives pierced their targets with perfect accuracy, and screams rang out one after another.

hunks.baseline: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect were already at the limit of their endurance, and their individual martial prowess wasn’t particularly high, making them easy prey.
hunks.sol: The martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect were already at the limits of their endurance, and none of them were particularly powerful. They were easy prey.

hunks.baseline: “No, that’s not how it works. An order is a right reserved for the strong.”
hunks.sol: “No. That’s not how it works. Giving orders is a right reserved for the strong.”

hunks.baseline: “I could see it if you were the Heaven Shaking Sword, but a wet-behind-the-ears fledgling like you dares?”
hunks.sol: “If you were the Heaven Shaking Sword, perhaps. But a wet-behind-the-ears fledgling like you dares?”

hunks.baseline: I closed my mouth at Pung Yang’s sneer. He wasn’t wrong. My decision to block him had been half courage and half foolhardiness.
hunks.sol: I fell silent at Pung Yang’s sneer. He wasn’t wrong. My decision to block his path had been equal parts courage and recklessness.

hunks.baseline: My mind felt like it was burning itself blank. Amid all the tangled thoughts, two faces surfaced.
hunks.sol: My mind felt as though it were burning itself blank. Amid the tangled thoughts, two faces surfaced.

hunks.baseline: The first was the Head Elder. He had been the most powerful and despair-inducing opponent I had ever faced. But back then, I’d had Jin Wikyung and the martial artists of the Jin Family to help me.
hunks.sol: The first was the Head Elder. He had been the strongest and most hopeless opponent I’d ever faced. But back then, I’d had Jin Wikyung and the martial artists of the Jin Family to help me.

hunks.baseline: No one. I had no one.
hunks.sol: No one. There was no one.

hunks.baseline: After taking the Temporary Strength Pill, Pung Yang had to be a master comparable to, or even stronger than, the Head Elder. And the only person left to face him was me.
hunks.sol: After taking the Temporary Strength Pill, Pung Yang had to be comparable to the Head Elder, if not stronger. And the only person left to face him was me.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps Jopil was the person who had forced me to face a genuine crisis. For the first time, I’d lost one of the subordinates I’d gained in the Murim, and I’d nearly died. Only after that had I managed to defeat the bastard.
hunks.sol: Perhaps Jopil was the one who had put me through my first true crisis. I had lost one of the subordinates I’d gained in the Murim for the first time, and I’d come within an inch of death. Only then had I managed to defeat the bastard.

hunks.baseline: The more I thought about it, the more curses came out. I wanted to see the face of whatever son of a bitch had made it.
hunks.sol: The more I thought about it, the more I wanted to curse. I wanted to see the face of whatever son of a bitch had made it.

hunks.baseline: “Once you’ve learned your place, curl up quietly.”
hunks.sol: “Now that you understand your place, crawl off somewhere and keep quiet.”

hunks.baseline: Watching Pung Yang act like the greatest master under heaven simply because he trusted that pill twisted my gut. If he’d only been around Jopil’s level, I might have found a way to deal with him…
hunks.sol: Watching Pung Yang act like the greatest master under heaven just because he had that pill twisted my gut. If he’d only been around Jopil’s level, I might have found some way to deal with him…

hunks.baseline: A forgotten fact suddenly flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: A fact I’d forgotten suddenly flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: There had been something nasty among the things Jopil possessed. What was it again?
hunks.sol: There had been something nasty among Jopil’s possessions. What was it again?

hunks.baseline: *The Blazing Flame Divine Pill.*[^4]
hunks.sol: *The Blazing Flame Divine Pill.*

hunks.baseline: A peerless divine elixir that granted half a jiazi of internal energy when consumed—but was also a double-edged sword that could kill its user through the fire qi contained within it.[^5]
hunks.sol: A peerless divine elixir that granted half a jiazi of internal energy when consumed—but also a double-edged sword that could kill its user with the fire qi it contained.[^4]

hunks.baseline: The next moment, I abruptly opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: The next moment, I abruptly spoke.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang, who had already passed me, stopped and turned around.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang, who had already walked past me, stopped and turned around.

hunks.baseline: I looked straight at his face, mottled with bewilderment and fury, and enunciated each word.
hunks.sol: I looked straight at his face, mottled with bewilderment and fury, and enunciated every word.

hunks.baseline: [^4]: The name literally combines “blazing flame” with “divine pill,” emphasizing the elixir’s dangerous fire qi.
[^5]: A *jiazi* is a sixty-year cycle; half a jiazi is thirty years.
hunks.sol: [^4]: A *jiazi* is a sixty-year cycle; half a jiazi is thirty years.
